mainEntity.name: Can an AI SEO audit help with voice search optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an AI SEO audit significantly contributes to voice search optimization. Voice search relies heavily on AI algorithms to understand natural language queries and provide relevant, concise answers. An AI SEO audit focuses on semantic content, structured data (like schema markup), and answering user intent, all of which are critical for ranking in voice search results. By optimizing these elements, your website becomes more discoverable for spoken queries.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, an AI SEO audit improves voice search optimization by focusing on semantic content, structured data, and user intent, all crucial for AI-driven voice queries.
